Info

Defines CppMethod domain model representing a C++ interface method.

class gen_um_test.core.model.cpp_method.CppMethod(name: str, return_type: str, parameters: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] = (), is_const: bool = False, is_noexcept: bool = False)[source]¶

Bases: object

Domain model representing a C++ interface member method.

Parameters:

  • name – Name of the method.

  • return_type – Return type of the method.

  • parameters – Sequence of (type, name) tuples for parameters.

  • is_const – Whether the method is const qualified.

  • is_noexcept – Whether the method is noexcept qualified.

property default_return_value: str¶

Returns sensible default return value for stub/fake implementations.

is_const: bool¶
is_noexcept: bool¶
property is_void: bool¶

Returns True if method returns void.

name: str¶

property params_call: str¶

Returns parameter names string for forwarding calls, e.g. “a, b”.

property params_signature: str¶

Returns parameter signature string, e.g. “int a, const std::string& b”.
